title: New shop
description: Making the plaza:stall shop and binding it to the trader

console: animus create greeter name=greeter world=world x=-2.5 y=64 z=-9.5
animus create trader type=minecraft:llama name=trader world=world x=4.5 y=64 z=-9.5

beats.result: the Shops screen lists town:bakery; the trader is selected
plaza:stall joins the list; chat: Created shops/plaza/stall.json, with the /animus shop stock hint
chat: Shop plaza:stall on trader, with [Undo]
the trader llama, now bound to plaza:stall

beats.caption: Hold an item and /animus shop stock adds an offer

beats.result: the empty shop closes; the bind line is still in chat

closing: plaza:stall is made, bound to the trader, and opens empty
